summary: The School District of Fort Atkinson opposes any termination or severe restriction of the E‑Rate program, arguing that such actions would impose an unfunded mandate on local taxpayers, jeopardize essential broadband and internal network infrastructure, compromise student privacy and cybersecurity, and widen the digital divide. The School District of Fort Atkinson argues that eliminating or severely limiting the E‑Rate program would impose an unfunded mandate, erode equitable digital access, compromise cybersecurity, jeopardize long‑term infrastructure investments, and undermine the FCC’s universal service mandate.
